game_concept: A strategy race set in Shadow Cave – Echo Chamber, a booming echo chamber: the spelunker must handle skeleton miners while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Stamina Climb: Keep climbing while stamina > 0, deciding when to rest inside the loop.
theme: Shadow Cave – Echo Chamber: a booming echo chamber

lose_condition: The rival reaches the crystal door first, or lives reach 0.
